headline: Maino dressed up as Rick Ross and recreated his viral speech Via: He committed to the Roza
body: Maino dressed up as Rick Ross and recreated his viral speech Via: He committed to the Rozay impression with the colorful shirt, chain and delivery—taking on the moment Ross went from declaring “I am totally innocent” to discussing Dubai, Paris and a big plate of rigatoni with “heavy marinara” That speech already sounded like something out of a comedy, so Maino turning it into a Halloween costume makes too much sense How’d he do with the impression?
